item.druzhina.commander_baton.follow: Right click: "Follow me!" - your soldiers walk behind you
item.druzhina.commander_baton.hold: Right click the ground: "Hold here!" - a line there, facing where you look
item.druzhina.commander_baton.charge: Shift + right click: "Charge!" - they attack every enemy around
druzhina.role.swordsman.desc: Sword and shield. Takes blows, parries, strikes back.
druzhina.role.spearman.desc: A pike or a boar spear: reaches the enemy first.
druzhina.role.axeman.desc: A halberd or a bardiche: hacks shields apart. Tough, guards worse.
druzhina.role.archer.desc: A bow. Shoots from behind the line, never hits friends.
druzhina.role.knight.desc: The best of the retinue: a yushman or bakhterets, a Rus sword, a shield. Dear, worth three.
druzhina.msg.nobody_hears: None of your soldiers are near
druzhina.msg.army_full: Your band is full: you cannot feed more than %s soldiers
druzhina.msg.baton_given: You were given a commander's baton to give orders with. Hover over it to read how.
druzhina.msg.dismiss_confirm: Shift + right click again to send %s home
druzhina.raid.coming: The lookouts sound the alarm: a band of bandits (%s) comes %s!
druzhina.gui.title: Muster
druzhina.gui.baton_hint: Right click a soldier: his gear; with an item in hand: give it; Shift+right click twice: dismiss
druzhina.role.crossbowman.desc: A heavy crossbow: slow, but it goes through armour.
druzhina.role.militia.desc: A pitchfork or a club, a gambeson. Cheap and weak.
druzhina.role.warrior.desc: A two-handed sword: long sweeping blows, but no shield.
item.druzhina.commander_baton.view: K - commander's view: lead your soldiers from above
druzhina.view.title: Commander's view
druzhina.view.none: None of your soldiers are near: hire them at a muster table
druzhina.view.pick_first: Pick soldiers first: left click one or drag a frame
druzhina.view.hint1: Left click - pick a soldier (drag - a frame of them, Shift - add, double click - all of that role), Ctrl+A - all
druzhina.view.hint2: Right click the ground - go and form up (drag - the width and facing of the front), right click an enemy - attack
druzhina.view.hint3: F follow · H hold · C charge · 1 2 3 line, column, wedge · WASD Space Shift Q E wheel middle drag - camera · K exit
druzhina.role.druzhinnik.desc: A prince's man: Rus mail or scale, a sword or an axe, a round shield.
druzhina.role.shieldbearer.desc: A pavise or a scutum and a short spear: a wall for the archers to stand behind.
druzhina.role.maceman.desc: A mace or a war hammer and a shield: plate is no trouble for him.
druzhina.role.foot_knight.desc: Plate and a great helm; a knightly sword and shield, or a poleaxe in both hands.
druzhina.role.horseman.desc: A mounted retainer in mail, sword and shield, his horse in mail. Cuts from the saddle.
druzhina.role.lancer.desc: The couched lance: a run-up and a crushing charge; his horse barded. A sword at his side.
druzhina.role.horse_archer.desc: Rides round the enemy at a bowshot and shoots at the gallop.
druzhina.role.mahout.desc: A war elephant: tramples and tosses on its tusks; an archer shoots from the howdah.
druzhina.gear.on_foot: On foot: looking for his horse
druzhina.gear.given: Given by you: you can take it back
druzhina.gear.own: His own kit: it cannot be taken, but you can put yours over it; he puts his aside and takes it up again when you take yours back
druzhina.gear.put: Put an item from your inventory here
druzhina.gear.slot.6: Spare weapon: a lancer takes the lance in the saddle and the sword on foot
